cold(true)
plugin({ type: "offline", name: "emptyurl" })
params({ onnx: "emptyurl.onnx" })
model_url("")

input({ channel: [1, 2], monitor: true })
steps([
  id("c1").extends("@k7-core/audio/comp").params({ Ratio: 0.5, Mode: "soft" }),
  id("d1")
    .extends("@k7-core/audio/delay")
    .engine("tape")
    .engines({ tape: { params: { Wow: 0.2 } } })
    .bypass(true),
  id("p1").plugin({ type: "internal", name: "Named" }),
  to([chain("@out")]),
])

steps([
  id("c1").extends("@k7-core/audio/comp").params({ A: [1, 2], B: { x: true }, C: null, D: true }),
  to([chain("@out")]),
])

cold(true)

params({ onnx: "emptyurl.onnx" })
model_url("")

input({ channel: [1, 2], monitor: true })
steps([
  id("c1").extends("@k7-core/audio/comp").params({ Ratio: 0.5, Mode: "soft" }),
  id("d1")
    .extends("@k7-core/audio/delay")
    .engine("tape")
    .engines({ tape: { params: { Wow: 0.2 } } })
    .bypass(true),
  id("p1").plugin({ type: "internal", name: "Named" }),
  to([chain("@out")]),
])
